lede_html: Awards rose by six to 56 this week while new tenders fell by four to 30, so more work is being booked than put out to bid. China Communications Construction (CCCC) took three of those awards, led by the US$864m Annaba Port facilities contract in Algeria. For bidders, the open windows worth working are in European grid equipment: Západoslovenská distribučná wants three-phase oil power transformers by 4 December, and Skellefteå Kraft wants 400/130kV units by 16 January.

deals_why.Annaba Port facilities construction, Alg: CCCC is now booked on a US$864m Algerian port job, so marine works suppliers should approach it as a buyer rather than compete for the main contract.
deals_why.At Tullkammarkajen: Halmstads Kommun is putting about US$51m into quay works, with bids due 18 December, a sizeable municipal port job for marine contractors.
deals_why.Three-phase oil power transformers VVN/V: A joint procurement worth about US$42m shows a Slovak grid operator buying transformers in volume; makers have until 4 December to bid.
deals_why.Ships for Marine Fisheries Monitoring: Croatia's agriculture ministry is buying fisheries monitoring vessels worth about US$36m, and shipyards have a short window that closes on 19 November.
deals_why.400/130kV transformers PT2 Lidmyran: Skellefteå Kraft is buying 400/130kV transformers worth about US$25m, and the deadline of 16 January gives makers time to price carefully.
deals_why.East Coast Railway infrastructure mainte: A US$116m maintenance award books CCCC on Malaysian rail upkeep, so subcontractors and equipment suppliers should pitch to CCCC directly.
deals_why.Electrical apparatus for switching or pr: ABB has won about US$85m of intelligent electronic devices in Belgium, which takes this buyer's protection equipment spend out of rivals' reach.
deals_why.Heating plant construction for the city: Ab Industry S.a. won the US$78m Jaworzno heating plant build and is now the contractor to approach for equipment and subcontract packages.
deals_why.Shenzhen Shawan River reservoir water qu: CCCC's third award this week, US$69m of reservoir water-quality work, shows it booking work at home as well as overseas.
deals_why.Electricity Power Lines Construction, Br: Enedis is tendering about US$62m of connection line works for 2027-2032, a multi-year job that will tie up the winning contractor's crews.
deals_why.Hydraulic works for BAYONNE Prissé heati: Equans Axima Concept has won US$45m of heating network hydraulic works, so pipe and pump suppliers should talk to it now.
deals_why.Whole House Retrofit 2026 - 2031: Wall Lag (Wales) Limited holds a US$33m retrofit award for 2026-2031, so materials suppliers should approach it for that period's supply.
